## About
Topp Automotive supplies materials and equipment for the collision and restoration industry across Pennsylvania, Delaware and New Jersey. We carry automotive paint, body shop supplies and marine refinishing products, along with the tools and shop equipment that go with them.
The store on E. Chester Pike is set up so you can see the variety first-hand. Our customers have said they feel "like kids in a candy store" while picking up what they need.
Our experienced and educated staff is here to help you find the right product for the job. We're rated 4.7 on Google from 79 reviews.

## Services
- Paint & Solvents: Automotive paint and the solvents to go with it. One reviewer mentions Kandies, Flakes and Pearls from FX and House of Kolor.
- Spray Guns & Accessories: Spray guns and the accessories that keep them running.
- Body Shop Tools & Equipment: Tools and equipment for collision and restoration shops.
- Adhesives, Sealers & Plastic Repair: Adhesives, sealers and plastic repair products, including Fibre-Glass Evercoat Maxim Multi-Fix Plastic Repair.
- Fillers & Putties: Fillers and putties for body repair.
- Coatings & Truck Bed Liners: Protective coatings and truck bed liner products, such as the U-POL Raptor Liner Kit.
- Marine Detailing Products: Marine refinishing and detailing products, with lines including Collinite and Pettit Marine Paint.

## FAQ
Q: What are your store hours?
A: Monday through Friday 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, Saturday 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, closed Sunday.

Q: Do you deliver?
A: Yes. Our fleet delivers to businesses in Pennsylvania, New Jersey and Delaware.

Q: Can you ship outside the tri-state area?
A: Yes. We ship within the United States.

Q: Do you carry custom paint like House of Kolor?
A: One reviewer said we stock a decent selection of Kandies, Flakes and Pearls from FX and House of Kolor. Call to check on a specific color.
